goal: Define two clean LoRA-ready base forms before production: offline ordinary Alicia and online Morning Star.

approved_master_refs.same_clothing_contrast_gate: If ordinary Alicia and Morning Star intentionally wear the same clothing, they still must separate at first glance by hair structure, eye design, star cue, posture, and virtual-vs-offline presence.
approved_master_refs.morning_star_anchor_rule: These two images are the Morning Star base design. Later simplified single-side-ponytail red-dress variants are not allowed to redefine the form.

shared_identity.face: soft oval youthful-but-adult face, warm sincere expression, clear attentive gaze
shared_identity.skin: fair warm luminous skin, bright healthy complexion, soft studio exposure
shared_identity.eyes: ordinary form has natural honey-hazel brown amber eyes with simple normal round pupils and no virtual markings; Morning Star uses soft champagne-gold to peach-gold virtual idol eyes with a gentle small star catchlight or subtle tiny star aperture and at most one faint soundwave crescent highlight while staying in the warm gold/coral family
shared_identity.ordinary_hair: long light brown to champagne blond everyday hair, loose and grounded, with a natural half-up tie or side-braid accent; it must not copy Morning Star's rose-gold low twin tails
shared_identity.morning_star_hair: must deliberately differ from ordinary hair: more virtual peach-gold or rose-gold, cleaner low twin tails or side bundles, ribbon-bound and controlled; hair must sit as designed low twin tails, side bundles, or two to three thick curled/blunt masses that hang close to the body, never many scattered flyaway tips or wind-lifted sideways hair
shared_identity.hair_accessory: ordinary form uses red ribbons; Morning Star may replace them with a larger fabric star ribbon, small metal star hairpiece, or soft luminous ribbon accents; use fabric and metal idol ornaments, avoid glass-shard ornaments
shared_identity.body: petite slender adult build, 160 cm, light active posture
shared_identity.same_clothing_contrast: Even if both forms intentionally wear the same clothing in a test image, ordinary Alicia remains an offline girl through loose everyday hair, natural round pupils, grounded posture, and no virtual markings; Morning Star remains an online virtual idol through peach-gold low twin tails, wine-red ribbons, small gold star hairpiece, soft champagne-peach virtual eyes, tiny star catchlight, and brighter singer presence.
must_match_across_forms: same soft face and warm gaze

eye color stays in the warm amber/gold/coral family, but ordinary uses honey-hazel round pupils and Morning Star uses softer champagne-peach virtual eyes with gentle star catchlight or a subtle tiny star aperture
hair stays in a warm blond/peach-gold family, but ordinary hair and Morning Star hair must be visibly different in styling, saturation, and silhouette
a red, coral, or gold ribbon/star accessory memory point

ordinary_alicia.role: offline ordinary Alicia Bell, everyday high-magic city girl and traveler
ordinary_alicia.visual_priority: simple, approachable, bright, LoRA-clean, first-glance offline rather than idol-avatar
ordinary_alicia.outfit: covered ivory blouse or light cardigan, simple wine-red A-line skirt, teal short shawl or small collar cape, brown low ankle boots, one small belt pouch or satchel, minimal gold trim, no sheer stockings, no high heels, no off-shoulder idol bodice
ordinary_alicia.props: none required; small folded magic-network tablet or simple satchel optional
ordinary_alicia.background: plain warm off-white or very light gray studio background
ordinary_alicia.lighting: bright soft studio lighting, no harsh shadows
avoid: stage lighting
dense holographic UI
idol costume exaggeration
rose-gold low twin tails
star-ring or soundwave pupils
sheer stockings
high-heeled stage shoes
off-shoulder idol bodice
complex skirt panels
dangling chains
busy city market

morning_star.role: online avatar and magical-network singer identity, Morning Star
morning_star.visual_priority: bold clean virtual idol design with a real stage silhouette, not a busy concert poster
morning_star.alternate_outfit_policy: Use alternate Morning Star idol outfits only when explicitly tagged. The default wine-red and ivory translucent-shawl idol outfit remains the normal starting design.
morning_star.outfit: lightweight off-shoulder virtual singer costume: wine-red and ivory main outfit with coral-gold and luminous amber accents; no green sleeve cuffs or shoulder-covering teal capelet; fitted opaque high waist bodice; readable compact A-line or bell idol skirt; restrained non-flying back hem; required short translucent ivory gauze shoulder shawl crossing the front chest and upper arms as decorative overlay only, never replacing bodice coverage; optional tiny teal trim only; slim wrist cuffs or small gloves below the wrist; very sheer ivory stockings with skin tone visible through the fabric and natural subtle gold soundwave embroidery; elegant high-heeled stage shoes or high-heeled ankle boots
morning_star.hair_and_accessories: controlled virtual peach-gold or rose-gold hair clearly different from ordinary loose hair, low ribbon-bound side locks or low twin tails and smooth curled/blunt ends that hang close to the torso, larger fabric star ribbon, small metal star hairpiece, subtle crystal earpiece, one small integrated star brooch, and soft champagne-gold to peach-gold virtual eyes with a gentle small star catchlight or subtle tiny star aperture and at most one faint soundwave crescent highlight
morning_star.props: floating orange-gold soundwave glyphs or one simple translucent magic-network panel, kept sparse and non-glassy
morning_star.background: plain pale gold, off-white, or very simple light studio background with only minimal projection accents
morning_star.lighting: bright warm key light, fair luminous skin, soft orange-gold rim light
avoid: dark concert stage
dense UI panels
circular magic floor dominating the image
overly dark skin
overexposed orange glow
too similar to ordinary Alicia's plain daily outfit
not idol-like enough or too close to travel clothes
design-by-piling-up, too many stacked idol accessories, too many stars, too many trims
green sleeve cuffs, teal arm sleeves, shoulder-covering green capelet, or heavy green upper-body fabric
transparent main bodice, transparent skirt, see-through chest coverage, swimsuit-like or sexualized off-shoulder design
opaque heavy stockings or gold stocking lines that look pasted on or mechanical
Morning Star hair too similar to ordinary loose daily hair
ordinary and Morning Star eyes looking identical when a virtual idol eye variation is requested
Morning Star eyes that look harsh, crimson, demonic, predatory, target-like, hypnotic, or overloaded with stacked color rings
hair exploding into many separate flyaway strands
frayed or scattered hair tips instead of gathered curled ends
hair lifted sideways by wind or floating away from the body
flat boots, bulky boots, ugly utilitarian shoes, or heavy travel footwear
giant rear skirt train, banner-like back panel, long flying upper cape tail, or wind-swept back hem
glass-shard color blocks or prismatic crystal chunks
oversized chest jewel or pendant dominating the torso
microphone stand
physical instruments

base_image_gates: plain or near-plain background only
skin must read bright, fair, and warm rather than dark or heavily shadowed
skirt silhouette must be simple and readable
no dense ribbons, chains, pouches, overlapping panels, or messy dangling accessories
no exploded hair mass, scattered/frayed hair tips, glassy shard decoration, or oversized chest gem
Morning Star hair must be controlled and close to the body; no wind-lifted sideways hair or floating hair trails
Morning Star full-body bases should use a lightweight off-shoulder idol top; no green sleeve cuffs, teal arm sleeves, or shoulder-covering green capelet
Morning Star must keep the short translucent ivory gauze shoulder shawl across the front chest and upper arms; the main bodice and skirt must remain opaque and modest
Morning Star default idol outfit must not mutate during normal pose, scene, view, or style expansion; use the explicit Morning Star alternate idol outfit branch for costume changes
ordinary and Morning Star must read very different at first glance, but share the same face, adult build, warm expression, fair skin, and warm amber/gold identity family on close inspection
same-clothing contrast tests must still separate ordinary Alicia and Morning Star by form identity, not only outfit

ordinary Alicia must keep honey-hazel brown amber eyes with simple normal round pupils, loose everyday light-brown/champagne hair, covered daily clothing, and practical low brown footwear; sheer stockings, high heels, off-shoulder idol bodice, rose-gold low twin tails, and virtual pupil marks fail the ordinary base gate
Morning Star stockings should be very sheer ivory with skin tone visible through the fabric and natural subtle gold soundwave embroidery, not heavy opaque stockings or pasted-on metallic stripes

Morning Star hair and eyes should visibly differ from ordinary form: virtual peach/rose-gold low twin-tail / side-bundle hair and soft champagne-peach eyes with a gentle small star catchlight or subtle tiny star aperture are required for the online avatar base; avoid harsh crimson color, target-like rings, or aggressive multi-ring pupils
Morning Star design must read clearly with a few identity points, not accessory pile-up
Morning Star full-body bases must show elegant high-heeled stage shoes or high-heeled ankle boots, not bulky or flat boots
Morning Star full-body bases must keep rear skirt hems and upper cape backs compact; no large flying back panels or banner-like trains
single character only
fully clothed opaque clothing
no readable text, logos, watermarks, split panels, or model-sheet layout
no physical lute, guitar, band instrument, handheld microphone, or microphone stand

pilot_plan.selection_rule: Do not scale to 120-image production until one full-body and one bust image for each form pass visual review.
